bagPolicy.summary: The Commonwealth Room hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: The Commonwealth Room hasn't published parking details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Commonwealth Room. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Commonwealth Room is a 21 and over venue with a full bar.
concessions.quote: We are a 21 and over venue with full bar.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating tickets are available for every show. Choose those tickets when you buy if you need the accommodation.
accessibility.quote: Accessible seating tickets are available for all shows at The Commonwealth Room.

reEntry.summary: The Commonwealth Room hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens on show days at the posted door time. Tickets are AXS Mobile ID tickets in the AXS app with no paper tickets, and groups should enter together since only one barcode appears. The venue is 21 and over.
ticketPickup.quote: The Commonwealth Room Box Office is open on show days at the posted door time.

gates.summary: Doors open at the posted door time. Show your tickets in the AXS app at the gate to scan in.
gates.quote: Show the tickets in-app at the gate to scan for entry.
